title: Trace
description: `seshi/trace/1`: the one canonical stored trace (X6.2), the immutable, content-addressed object at `owners/<owner>/sessions/<archive_id>/trace.<content_hash>.json.gz`. Evolved from trajectory-v1: `records` are trajectory-v1 records with optional fields for what raw used to keep (X6.3), `llm_calls` holds model and token usage per LLM call, and `provenance` says where the data came from. `events` and `content_hash` are derived from the records exactly as before (spec/layout.md), so hashes do not change. Letta (trajectory-v1), OTLP and ATIF are rendered from it on read.

content_hash.description: sha256 of what was said: `source` (plus `@from_record` for a continuation), then each event's role and text (spec/layout.md).

source.description: The meta record's `source` (`claude-code`, `codex`, an ATIF document's harness, …).

format.description: The format the session was filed under (the archive id derives from it). Traces written before 0.15 call it `agent`; readers take `format ?? agent`.

started_at.description: The earliest event timestamp, as shipped; null when no event has one that parses.

ended_at.description: The latest event timestamp, as shipped; null when no event has one that parses.

records.description: The records after redaction and NUL stripping, meta record first: what `events` were derived from.

llm_calls.description: The LLM calls the session made, referenced from records by `llm_call`. Absent when the source records none.

TraceRecord.description: One record: trajectory-v1, plus optional fields trajectory-v1 lacks.

TraceMetaRecord.description: The first record, and only the first: what the session is.

model.description: The session's main model, when the source names one.

agent_version.description: The version of the agent harness that wrote the transcript.

TraceTextRecord.description: A user prompt, a system message, an observation from the environment, or the model's reasoning.

synthetic.description: User records only: the agent or a plugin added this text to the user's turn, not the member (an OpenCode part marked `synthetic`, a pi extension's custom message). The model saw it.

omitted.description: User records only: how many injected items the integrator that added them asked seshi to leave out (`session_capture.omit`), here. Their text is not stored: the record's content is empty.

TraceAssistantRecord.description: What the assistant said, or the tools it called (or both).

id.description: The tool call id the agent assigned.

args.description: The arguments as the agent sent them (usually JSON).

ok.description: Whether the call succeeded, when the source says.

withheld.description: Set when the result's content was replaced: the call touched a sensitive file or printed a secret (F2), or model review withheld it (`review`, F3.1).

duration_ms.description: How long the call ran, when the source says.

RecordId.description: The record's id in its source (a message uuid, a span id), for provenance.

LlmCallRef.description: The `id` of the entry in `llm_calls` that produced this record.

LlmCall.description: One request to a model: which model, when, what it cost in tokens and how it ended.

stop_reason.description: Why generation stopped, in the provider's words.

request_id.description: The provider's request or response id.

error.description: The error the call ended with, if it failed.

TokenUsage.description: Token counts as the provider reports them.

TraceEvent.description: One unit of a trace. `index` is stable for the life of the object; `text` is the canonical string excerpts are validated against.

timestamp.description: The record's timestamp as shipped; null when it does not parse.

TraceMetadata.description: Lineage and scope attached at ingest, plus the meta record's `cwd`, `git_branch` and `model`.

parent_session_id.description: The session this one was spawned by (a subagent, a fork).
